extraction_notes: Titled 'תוצאות סקר 13.8'. PDF does not name the pollster or commissioner; taken from CEC metadata (טאטיקה מחקרים ומדיה for זמן ישראל). Fieldwork 12/8 10:00 to 13/8 13:00 (year 2026). Method: internet panel + phone completions -> mixed. Initial sample: 9,000 SMS with link + 31 phone calls = 9,031; 582 answered, 56 excluded as unfit/out of quota -> 500 respondents; 93% did not participate -> response rate recorded as 7.0. Margin of error 4.4%. Only one vote-intention question.
